data.description: Excavation in hard rock (blasting prohibited) using rock breakers by mechanized method including breaking, loading in tippers, disposal, trimming bottom and side slopes.

data.name: Hard Rock Excavation (Breaker-Manual)
data.description: Excavation in hard rock (blasting prohibited) using rock breakers by manual method including breaking, loading in tippers, disposal, trimming bottom and side slopes.

data.name: Hard Rock Excavation (Controlled Blasting)
data.description: Excavation in hard rock using controlled drilling, blasting and breaking including trimming, loading and disposal within all lifts and lead up to 1000 m.

data.name: Roadway Excavation – Marshy Soil
data.description: Excavation for roadway in marshy soil with hydraulic excavator (0.9 cum bucket), including cutting, loading into tippers, disposal within all lifts and lead up to 1000 m, trimming of bottom and side slopes as per required lines, grades and cross sections.

data.name: Removal of Unserviceable Soil
data.description: Removal of unserviceable soil including excavation, loading and disposal up to 1000 m lead, excluding replacement with suitable soil, which shall be paid separately under Clause 305.

data.name: Rock Slope Pre-Splitting
data.description: Pre-splitting of rock excavation slopes by controlled blasting, including drilling, blasting accessories, collection of excavated rock by 80 HP dozer, loading by front-end loader, and disposal within all lifts up to 1000 m lead, as specified in Clause 303.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Ordinary Soil (Manual)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in ordinary soil by manual means (depth up to 3 m), including setting out, shoring and bracing, removal of stumps and deleterious matter, dressing of sides and bottom, backfilling as required, and utilizing remaining earth locally for road work.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Ordinary Soil (Mechanical)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in ordinary soil by mechanical means (depth up to 3 m), including setting out, shoring and bracing, removal of stumps and deleterious matter, dressing of sides and bottom, backfilling as required, and utilizing remaining earth locally for road work.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Ordinary Rock (Manual)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in ordinary rock not requiring blasting by manual means (depth up to 3 m), including setting out, shoring and bracing, dressing, backfilling, and utilizing remaining material locally for road work.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Ordinary Rock (Mechanical)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in ordinary rock not requiring blasting by mechanical means, including all incidental works and backfilling as specified.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Hard Rock (Blasting)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in hard rock requiring blasting by manual means, including setting out, shoring, dressing, backfilling, and utilizing remaining excavated material locally for road work.

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Hard Rock (Mechanical)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation in hard rock where blasting is prohibited, by mechanical means, including dressing, backfilling, and utilizing remaining excavated material locally for road work.

data.name: Excavation in Marshy Soil - Manual (Depth upto 3 m)
data.description: Earth work in excavation of road formation in marshy soil complete as per Technical Specifications - Manual Means - Depth upto 3 m

data.name: Foundation Excavation – Marshy Soil (Mechanical)
data.description: Earthwork in excavation of foundation of structures in marshy soil by mechanical means, including setting out, shoring and bracing, removal of stumps and deleterious matter, dressing of sides and bottom, backfilling to the required extent, and utilizing the remaining earth locally for road work.

data.name: Scarifying Granular Road Surface
data.description: Scarifying the existing granular road surface to a depth of 50 mm and disposal of scarified material within all lifts and leads up to 1000 metres.

data.name: Scarifying Bituminous Road Surface
data.description: Scarifying the existing bituminous road surface to a depth of 50 mm and disposal of scarified material within all lifts and lead up to 1000 metres by mechanical means.

data.name: Embankment Construction – Borrow Earth
data.description: Construction of embankment with approved material obtained from borrow pits, including transporting to site, spreading, grading to the required slope, and compacting with all lifts and leads to meet the requirements of Table 300-2.

data.name: Embankment Construction – Excavated Material
data.description: Construction of embankment using approved material deposited at site from roadway cutting and excavation from drain and foundation of other structures, including grading and compaction to meet the requirements of Table 300-2.

data.name: Subgrade & Earthen Shoulder Construction
data.description: Construction of sub-grade and earthen shoulders with approved material obtained from borrow pits, including transporting to site, spreading, grading to the required slope, and compacting with all lifts and leads to meet the requirements of Table 300-2.

data.name: Ground Loosening for Subgrade
data.description: Loosening the ground up to 500 mm below the sub-grade level, watering, grading, and compacting in layers to meet the requirements of Table 300-2 for compacting original ground supporting sub-grade construction.

data.name: Ground Loosening for Embankment
data.description: Loosening, leveling, and compacting the original ground supporting embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at optimum moisture content (OMC), and compacted by rolling to achieve the minimum dry density specified in Table 300-2.

data.name: Topsoil Stripping & Reapplication
data.description: Stripping and storing topsoil by the roadside at 15 m intervals and reapplying it on embankment slopes, cut slopes, and other areas where the available embankment material is not conducive to plant growth.

data.name: Topsoil Stripping – Borrow Areas
data.description: Stripping topsoil from borrow areas located in agricultural fields, storing it at a suitable place, and spreading and relaying it after excavation to maintain the fertility of the agricultural field, finishing to the required levels and to the satisfaction of the farmer.

data.name: Turfing with Live Sods
data.description: Furnishing and laying live sods of perennial turf-forming grass on embankment slopes, verges, or other locations as shown on the drawings or directed by the Engineer, including ground preparation, fetching of sods, and watering.

data.name: Seed Bed Preparation & Seeding
data.description: Preparation of seed bed on previously laid topsoil, furnishing and placing seeds, fertilizer, mulching material, applying bituminous emulsion at 0.23 litres/sqm, laying and fixing jute netting, and watering for 3 months as per Clause 308.

data.name: Seeding and Mulching on Slopes
data.description: Seeding and Mulching - Providing and laying of seeding and mulching on slopes complete as per Technical Specifications

data.name: Unlined Surface Drain – Soil (Mechanical)
data.description: Construction of unlined surface drain of average cross-sectional area 0.40 sqm in soil by mechanical means to specified lines, grades, levels, and dimensions as per Clauses 301 and 309. Excavated material to be used in embankment within a lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m).

data.name: Unlined Surface Drain – Soil (Manual)
data.description: Construction of unlined surface drain of average cross-sectional area 0.40 sqm in soil by manual means to specified lines, grades, levels, and dimensions as per Clauses 301 and 309. Excavated material to be used in embankment within a lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m).

data.name: Unlined Surface Drain – Rock (Mechanical)
data.description: Construction of unlined surface drain of average cross-sectional area 0.40 sqm in ordinary rock by mechanical means to specified lines, grades, levels, and dimensions as per approved design and Clauses 301–309. Excavated material to be used in embankment at site.

data.name: Unlined Surface Drain – Rock (Manual)
data.description: Construction of unlined surface drain of average cross-sectional area 0.40 sqm in ordinary rock by manual means to specified lines, grades, levels, and dimensions as per approved design and Clauses 301–309. Excavated material to be used in embankment at site.

data.name: Subsurface Drain with Perforated Pipe
data.description: Construction of subsurface drain with 100 mm internal diameter perforated pipe (metal, asbestos cement, cement concrete, or PVC), perforations ranging from 3–6 mm, 150 mm bedding below pipe, 300 mm cushion above pipe, excavation section 450 × 550 mm, with excavated material utilized in the roadway.

data.name: Aggregate Subsurface Drain
data.description: Construction of aggregate subsurface drain of size 300 mm × 450 mm with aggregates conforming to Table 300-4. Excavated material to be utilized in the roadway.

data.name: Underground Drain at Pavement Edge
data.description: Construction of underground drain at the edge of pavement with inside dimensions of 1 m × 1 m, lined with 20 cm thick RCC and covered with a 10 cm thick RCC slab for urban roads.

data.name: Formation Surface Preparation
data.description: Preparation and surface treatment of formation by removing mud and slurry, watering to maintain the desired moisture content, trimming to the required line, grade and profile, and rolling with an 8–10 tonne smooth-wheeled roller, complete as per Clause 310.

data.name: Rock Fill Embankment
data.description: Construction of rock fill embankment using broken hard rock fragments not exceeding 300 mm in size, laid in layers not exceeding 500 mm thick, including filling surface voids with stone spalls, blinding the top layer with granular material, and compacting with a vibratory road roller, complete as per Clause 313.

data.name: Hilly Area Excavation – Soil
data.description: Excavation in soil in hilly areas by mechanical means, including cutting and trimming of side slopes and disposal of excavated earth with all lifts and lead up to 1000 metres.

data.name: Hilly Area Excavation – Ordinary Rock
data.description: Excavation in ordinary rock in hilly areas not requiring blasting by mechanical means, including cutting and trimming of slopes and disposal of excavated material with all lifts and lead up to 1000 metres.

data.name: Hilly Area Excavation – Hard Rock
data.description: Excavation in hard rock in hilly areas requiring blasting by mechanical means, including trimming of slopes and disposal of excavated material with all lifts and lead up to 1000 metres.

data.name: Fly Ash Embankment
data.description: Construction of embankment using fly ash conforming to IRC:SP:58-2001, obtained from coal or lignite-based thermal power stations, spread and compacted in 200 mm thick layers at optimum moisture content (OMC), complete as specified in IRC:SP:58-2001 and approved plans.

data.name: Plain Cement Concrete (1:3:6)
data.description: Plain cement concrete (1:3:6) using 40 mm nominal size crushed stone aggregate, mechanically mixed, placed in foundation, compacted by vibration, and cured for 14 days.

data.name: RCC Pipe Culvert – Single Row (1000 mm)
data.description: Laying NP4/prestressed reinforced cement concrete pipes of 1000 mm diameter for culverts on first-class granular bedding in a single row, including fixing collars with 1:2 cement mortar, excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete, and masonry works in headwalls and parapets.

data.name: RCC Pipe Culvert – Single Row (1200 mm)
data.description: Laying NP4/prestressed reinforced cement concrete pipes of 1200 mm diameter for culverts on first-class granular bedding in a single row, including fixing collars with 1:2 cement mortar, excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete, and masonry works in headwalls and parapets.

data.name: RCC Pipe Culvert – Double Row (1000 mm)
data.description: Laying NP4/prestressed reinforced cement concrete pipes of 1000 mm diameter for culverts on first-class granular bedding in a double row, including fixing collars with 1:2 cement mortar, excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete, and masonry works in headwalls and parapets.

data.name: RCC Pipe Culvert – Double Row (1200 mm)
data.description: Laying NP4/prestressed reinforced cement concrete pipes of 1200 mm diameter for culverts on first-class granular bedding in a double row, including fixing collars with 1:2 cement mortar, excluding excavation, protection works, backfilling, concrete, and masonry works in headwalls and parapets.

data.name: Geotextile Subsurface Drain (200 mm)
data.description: Construction of 200 mm diameter subsurface drain using carbon black treated geotextiles with physical properties as per Clause 702.2.3, formed into a stable geocomposite structure with geotextile-wrapped joints to prevent soil ingress, including excavation and backfilling, complete as per Clause 702 and approved drawings.

data.name: Narrow Filter Subsurface Drain
data.description: Construction of a narrow filter subsurface drain consisting of a porous or perforated pipe laid in a narrow trench surrounded by geotextile filter fabric with a minimum overlap of 450 mm, including excavation and backfilling, complete as per Clauses 702.3 and 309.3.5.

data.name: Paving Fabric Layer
data.description: Providing and laying paving fabric over a tack coat of VG-30 bitumen applied at 1 kg/sqm on a cleaned and repaired surface to form a water-resistant membrane and crack-retarding layer, including rolling with a pneumatic roller as specified in Table 704-16.

data.name: Geogrid Crated Apron
data.description: Providing, preparing, and laying a geogrid crated apron (1 m × 5 m × 600 mm), including excavation, backfilling, geogrid connectors, cross ties, polymer braids, filling with stone (minimum 200 mm size), packing with stone spalls, laying geotextile to prevent migration of fines, and construction as per Clauses 704 and 2503.3.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Galvanized Steel Strips
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of galvanized carbon steel strips for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Copper Strips
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of copper strips for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Aluminium Strips
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of aluminium strips for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Stainless Steel Strips
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of stainless steel strips for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Polymer Strips
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of glass fibre reinforced polymer (GFRP), fibre reinforced polymer (FRP), or polymeric strips for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – Geogrids
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforcing elements of synthetic geogrids for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Reinforced Earth – RCC Facing
data.description: Assembling, joining, and laying reinforced concrete (RCC) facing elements for reinforced earth structures.

data.name: Remove Cement Concrete Wearing Coat
data.description: Removal of existing cement concrete wearing coat including disposal, without causing damage to any part of the bridge structure, and disposal of dismantled material with all lifts and lead up to 1000 m, complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Remove Asphalt Wearing Coat
data.description: Removal of existing 50 mm thick asphaltic concrete wearing coat laid over 12 mm thick mastic asphalt, including disposal with all lifts and lead up to 1000 m.

data.name: Grouting Nipples Installation
data.description: Providing and inserting nipples with approved fixing compound after drilling holes for grouting, including subsequent removal and sealing of holes after completion of cement or epoxy grouting, complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Crack Sealing – Cement Grout
data.description: Sealing cracks and porous concrete by injection grouting through nipples using cement grout, complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Crack Sealing – Cement Mortar Grout
data.description: Sealing cracks and porous concrete by injection grouting through nipples using 1:1 cement mortar grout, complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Polymer Concrete Patching
data.description: Patching damaged concrete surfaces with polymer concrete using curing compounds, initiator, and promoter, applied as per the manufacturer's instructions and approved by the Engineer.

data.name: Crack Sealing – Epoxy Grout
data.description: Sealing cracks and porous concrete by injection grouting through nipples using epoxy grout, complete as per Clause 2803.1.

data.name: Epoxy Mortar Repair
data.description: Applying epoxy mortar over leached, honeycombed, and spalled concrete surfaces, including exposed reinforcement, complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Shotcrete Concrete Repair
data.description: Removal of defective concrete, surface cleaning, and application of shotcrete using compressed air with cement, sand, coarse aggregates, water, and quick-setting compound, conforming to Clause 2807 and relevant IS specifications.

data.name: Pre-packed Polymer Mortar Repair
data.description: Applying pre-packed cement-based polymer mortar with a minimum compressive strength of 45 MPa at 28 days for replacement of spalled concrete.

data.name: Epoxy Bonding of Concrete
data.description: Epoxy bonding of new concrete to existing concrete surfaces.

data.name: External Prestressing – High Tensile Steel
data.description: Providing external prestressing using high tensile steel wires/strands, including drilling for passage, stressing operations, accessories, and grouting, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: External Prestressing – High Tensile Strands
data.description: Providing external prestressing using high tensile steel wires/strands, including drilling for passage, stressing operations, accessories, and grouting, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: External Prestressing – Steel Wires
data.description: Providing external prestressing using high tensile steel wires/strands, including drilling for passage, stressing operations, accessories, and grouting, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Bearing Replacement
data.description: Replacement of bridge bearings complete as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Bearing Rectification
data.description: Rectification of bridge bearings as per Technical Specifications.

data.name: Expansion Joint Replacement
data.description: Replacement of bridge expansion joints complete as per approved drawings.

data.name: RCC Railing Replacement
data.description: Replacement of damaged reinforced cement concrete (RCC) railing.

data.name: Crash Barrier Replacement
data.description: Replacement of damaged crash barrier.

data.name: Mild Steel Railing Replacement
data.description: Replacement of damaged mild steel railing.

data.name: Crash Barrier Repair
data.description: Repair of concrete crash barrier using M-30 grade cement concrete by cutting and trimming damaged portions to regular shape, cleaning the repair area, and applying fresh concrete.

data.name: RCC Railing Repair
data.description: Repair of RCC M30 railing to restore it to its original shape.

data.name: Steel Railing Repair
data.description: Repair of steel railing to restore it to its original shape, assuming damage to the extent of approximately 10 percent.

data.name: Boulder Apron – Dry Laid
data.description: Providing and laying boulder apron on river bed for scour protection using stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each, laid dry without wire crates, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Boulder Apron – Wire Crates
data.description: Providing and laying boulder apron in GI wire crates made of 4 mm diameter wire conforming to IS:280 and IS:4826 with 100 × 100 mm woven mesh, including extra wire for laps and joints, filled with stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each.

data.name: Concrete Block Apron (M15)
data.description: Providing and laying apron using cast-in-situ cement concrete blocks of size 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.5 m in M15 grade concrete with minimum cement content of 250 kg/cum, complete as per IRC:21.

data.name: Stone Pitching on Slopes
data.description: Providing and laying stone pitching on slopes over prepared filter media, including dry laid boulder apron at the toe of embankment, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Concrete Block Pitching
data.description: Providing and laying pitching on slopes over prepared filter media using 0.3 × 0.3 × 0.3 m M15 grade cement concrete blocks, including dry laid boulder apron at the toe of embankment, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Filter Material Under Pitching
data.description: Providing and laying filter material beneath pitching on slopes, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Geotextile Filter Layer
data.description: Laying geotextile filter between pitching and embankment slopes to prevent loss of embankment material through pitching voids while allowing free movement of water without uplift pressure.

data.name: Rubble Stone Flooring
data.description: Providing and laying flooring over cement concrete bedding using rubble stone laid in 1:3 cement mortar, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Concrete Block Flooring
data.description: Providing and laying flooring over cement concrete bedding using M15 grade cement concrete blocks, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Dry Rubble Flooring
data.description: Construction of dry rubble flooring for cross-drainage works of relatively less important structures.

data.name: Curtain Wall – Stone Masonry
data.description: Construction of curtain wall using stone masonry in 1:3 cement mortar, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Curtain Wall – Concrete (M15)
data.description: Construction of curtain wall using M15 grade cement concrete, complete as per drawings and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Flexible Boulder Apron
data.description: Construction of 1 m thick flexible apron comprising loose stone boulders weighing not less than 40 kg each beyond the curtain wall.

data.name: Gabion Retaining Structure
data.description: Providing and constructing gabion retaining structures using galvanized steel wire crates (7 × 3 × 0.6 m) divided into 1.5 m compartments with double-twisted mesh, filled with boulders of minimum 200 mm size, complete as per IS:280, IS:4826 and Technical Specifications.

data.name: Gabion Erosion Control
data.description: Providing and constructing gabion structures for erosion control, river training and protection works using galvanized steel wire crates (2 × 1 × 0.3 m) divided into 1 m compartments with double-twisted mesh, filled with boulders of minimum 200 mm size, complete as per IS:280, IS:4826 and Technical Specifications.
